processDescription: 5-axis CNC milling centers provide simultaneous multi-axis interpolation for complex titanium components. The ability to tilt the tool relative to the workpiece surface maintains optimal chip load and extends tool life, critical for difficult-to-machine titanium alloys, specifically for pin. Precision pin for Fastener, Medical present unique challenges: Cylindrical OD tolerance ±0.005 mm with chamfer/radius control. Tight straightness (< 0.02 mm over 50 mm) for press-fit applications.
heatControl: High-pressure coolant-through-spindle (50–70 bar) with coated carbide tooling. Adaptive trochoidal milling paths reduce radial engagement to control heat generation.
flatnessControl: Stress-relieved raw material and sequenced roughing/finishing passes. Heat-sink fixturing for thin-wall sections minimizes thermal distortion.
capabilitiesDescription: Precision machining capability for Seal face grinding/lapping, utilizing multi-axis CNC centers with in-process inspection and SPC quality control.
